approach: A complete Responsive Component Library solution should implement: Buttons, cards, badges, and form controls; Variables and design tokens; Parameterized mixins; Component modifiers; Modular stylesheet organization.
acceptance_checks: Compile every documented entrypoint with a pinned/project-local Dart Sass CLI.
Compare selectors and declaration output against explicit expectations.
Test rendered behavior at representative viewports and keyboard states.
Document token/API names, deprecated constructs, CSS output trade-offs, and limitations.
review_notes: This reference file is repository-only and is not exposed by the learner-facing project API. It is a solution outline, not a claim that a full finished portfolio or website artifact was built.
